description: Quote prepaid call packs. This tool does not buy a pack and does not create a payment. POST https://api.agentpaywire.com/v1/credits with calls 15, 100, or 1000, paid by x402 or L402. Packs last 90 days. One call is one request on the prepaid routes. break_even_singles is the number of 0.01 USDC catalog calls that cost the same as the pack.
name: quote_credit_packs
